event.name: New Haven Greenspace Volunteering
event.descriptionText: Urban Resources Initiative supports 30+ local volunteer groups supporting Community Greenspaces throughout New Haven.  These groups host volunteer activities that include weeding, mulching, planting,  natural areas management, and canvassing. Please dress to work outdoors and get dirty, and bring drinking water.  Bug spray, sunscreen, sturdy shoes, long sleeves, long pants, and hats are encouraged and recommended.  Use this link: < tinyurl.com/NHVgreenspace > to find and sign up for any of the posted activities.
